features.behavior: The rules report placeholder mismatches, empty and missing translations, key names used as translations and text left untranslated, with the same result every time.
JSON (nested, flat, Chrome, ARB), YAML, gettext, Android, iOS and Xcode String Catalog files are read into one key to string shape.
Each key's usage is found in the code for t("key") style calls, whole-sentence keys and Android references.
Each string gets fail, review, warn or ok from rules and scores, and the report v1 and the exit code follow --warn, --fail and --fail-on.
features.verify: uv run --quiet --with-requirements requirements-gate.txt pytest -q services/check/tests services/score/tests

features.behavior: The check command sends code context to the scorer, never reads symlinked files or files outside --src, caches scores outside the project, rejects a planted cache, requires two scorers to agree, and reports unscored strings.
Model calls go through the local Claude Code and Codex CLIs with acting tools off and fail cleanly when the CLI fails.
features.verify: uv run --quiet --with-requirements requirements-gate.txt pytest -q services/llm/tests services/llm_codex/tests

features.behavior: The sdist and the wheel pass twine check and hold exactly the files pyproject.toml names; each installs into a clean environment, and each installed command prints its version, finds the known problems in tests/e2e, passes the clean file, and exits 2 on an unreadable file.

One version in pyproject.toml, the package, --version and the changelog; README links are absolute; every workflow action is pinned to a commit; the release workflow cannot be started by a push and uploads only after the gate and the package check, with no stored credential.
The default scorer reaches precision at least 0.9 at recall at least 0.7 on the known-truth Japanese benchmark (makes model calls).
